_meta.name: Academic Confidence and Readiness

subs.STUDY_PREF: study preferences (reported as preferences, not fixed learning styles)

_meta.scoring: SE_c = mean of SE and SE_CAREER items for cluster c scaled 0-100. This module does NOT change Final_c. It produces: confidence gap = Aptitude_c minus SE_c (gap above 20 = hidden confidence gap, below -20 = overconfidence), test anxiety band, study tips, decision style, career maturity band, awareness percent (below 40 percent = needs exploration). See section 11 of the scoring document.
_meta.note: Verify exam names and routes yearly before release.
